sections.heading: Business
sections.markdown: Industrials / Building Products & Equipment · Indonesia. PT Arwana Citramulia Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes ceramic tiles in Indonesia and internationally. It also offers porcelain and granite tiles under the Arna, Arwana Ceramics, and UNO brands. The company was formerly known as PT Arwana Citra Mulia and changed its name to PT Arwana Citramulia Tbk in November 1993. PT Arwana Citramulia Tbk was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia.
